home.title: Home
home.summary: Your dashboard — recent projects, activity, open lab work, upcoming stability samples, and pending approvals.
home.purpose: A real, honest dashboard, not a mockup: every number comes from your own persisted data, and every section shows an honest empty state when there is nothing to show yet.
quickStart: Open a recent project to jump straight into it.
Check Pending approvals for anything waiting on you.
limitations: Bounded to your 5 most recently updated projects — this is a real bound, not a silent cap.

projects.title: Projects
projects.summary: Every formulation project you've created, independent of which workspace you're using.
projects.purpose: The home for the full project list — open, create, and see each project's dossier status at a glance.
quickStart: Click New project.
Pick a product family and packaging SKU.
Fill in name, market, and target batch size.

formulation.title: Formulation
formulation.summary: The formula grid, versions, cost, compatibility, safety, and packaging — your daily working surface.
formulation.purpose: Build and refine a formula, save immutable numbered versions, and see cost/compatibility/safety findings update as you edit.
prerequisites: An open project (from Projects or Home).
quickStart: Add a line: pick a material, phase, and percentage.
Mark one line q.s. to auto-fill the rest to 100%.
Save version once you're happy — this requires a change reason.
warnings: A saved version is immutable — editing it again creates a new version, never an in-place edit.
roleNotes: Approving a version to pilot or production status requires an authorized human role — no automated actor can ever approve one.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.summary: A real constraint-solving optimizer bound to this project's current working draft.
optimization.purpose: Pick candidate materials, set functional-group constraints and objectives, and let the solver propose a formula — never overwriting your saved version.
prerequisites: An open project with a working draft.
quickStart: Add candidate materials and constraints.
Run — review the result, then Apply to draft if you like it.
limitations: No builder yet for composition/ratio/conditional constraints — only functional-group constraints, property targets, and a cost ceiling.

optimizer.title: Optimizer (standalone)
optimizer.summary: A standalone what-if cost calculator — not bound to any project.
optimizer.purpose: Quick, project-less cost exploration, genuinely distinct from the project-bound Optimization workspace.
quickStart: Enter materials and percentages directly to see a cost estimate.

doe.title: Design of Experiments
doe.summary: Plan and analyze a statistically valid formulation or process experiment.
doe.purpose: Turn a real saved formula version into a structured experiment: factors, responses, a generated run sheet, and a fitted statistical model.
prerequisites: A real saved formula version as the study's baseline — never the working draft.
quickStart: Create a study through the 9-step wizard.
Record each run's observed responses.
Run the analysis once enough data is in.
limitations: Some design types and fraction sizes are refused outright rather than faked — see the Design of Experiments guide chapter for the exact limits.
An analysis-results export can't be re-imported as a native analysis.

reverseFormulation.title: Reverse Formulation
reverseFormulation.summary: Given a competitor or benchmark product, proposes evidence-scored candidate formulas — decision support, never an auto-approved formula.
reverseFormulation.purpose: Start from a declared ingredient list (and optional lab analysis) and get ranked candidates with a formula-fit score and a separately-labeled evidence-confidence score.
quickStart: Create a study and enter the benchmark product's declared ingredients.
Set your target and constraints.
Generate candidates, then save or convert the one you want.
warnings: A converted formulation always starts unapproved with no inherited approval — even from a well-scored candidate.
limitations: Candidate conversion refuses, visibly, if a candidate's material has left the catalog since it was generated.

laboratory.title: Laboratory
laboratory.summary: Trials, test definitions, and corrective actions for the selected project and version.
laboratory.purpose: Run real lab trials against a frozen formula snapshot, record weighing/process/test data, and manage deviations.
prerequisites: An open project; a version selector lets you pick which saved version's trials to view.
quickStart: Create a trial from the working draft or a saved version.
Move it through planned → in progress → completed as work happens.
Open a test's own Method entry to choose its primary standard, inspect alternatives, or view the full procedure.
roleNotes: Only a human can mark a trial completed.
warnings: A superseded standard must be explicitly acknowledged before it can be selected.
limitations: Existing free-text method references are not auto-converted into standards — they stay visible as an unresolved legacy reference until a chemist creates the structured standard/method.

stability.title: Stability
stability.summary: Stability studies, samples, results, and trends for the selected project and version.
stability.purpose: Track a formula's stability over time against real storage conditions and test definitions, with automatic failure detection.
prerequisites: An open project; a version selector.
quickStart: Create a study, then Generate samples.
Record a result when a sample is due.
warnings: Trend projections are always labeled "experimental estimate — human review required," never a shelf-life claim.
limitations: No automatic shelf-life prediction — deliberately not implemented.

regulatory.title: Regulatory
regulatory.summary: Kenya/EAC regulatory classification, rule evaluation, evidence confirmations, and human review.
regulatory.purpose: See your formula's deterministic regulatory classification and evaluate it against jurisdiction rules, then record a real human review.
prerequisites: A saved formula version, a jurisdiction, and (where relevant) a packaging SKU.
quickStart: Pick your version, jurisdiction, and acting role.
Click Evaluate to see findings.
roleNotes: Verifying a rule or recording a formal review requires an authorized regulatory/quality/administrator role.
limitations: Seed rules ship not_verified until a qualified reviewer confirms them.

dossiers.title: Dossiers
dossiers.summary: Build a per-version, per-jurisdiction regulatory dossier, including a real PDF/DOCX export.
dossiers.purpose: Assemble requirements, evidence, and reviews into one dossier per formula version and jurisdiction, then export it.
prerequisites: A real saved formula version — never a working draft.
quickStart: Create a dossier against a saved version and jurisdiction.
Work through Requirements and the Evidence Library.
roleNotes: Exporting a PDF/DOCX requires an authorized regulatory/quality/administrator role — the buttons are hidden otherwise, and no history record is created for a blocked attempt.
limitations: No dedicated export-history viewer screen yet, though every attempt is recorded.

claimsLabels.title: Claims & Labels
claimsLabels.summary: Manage product claims and product labels for a formula version, including an artwork/consistency workflow.
claimsLabels.purpose: Draft claims linked to real dossier evidence, build label content, and check formula-label consistency before printing.
quickStart: Create a claim or label.
Link evidence and record a formal review.
roleNotes: Only a formal review from an authorized regulatory/quality/administrator role changes a claim's true status.
limitations: No full graphic-design artwork editor — upload/preview/approve/reject/replace only.

approval.title: Approval
approval.summary: Readiness overview, blockers, approval policies, and decision history for the selected project.
approval.purpose: See exactly what blocks a formula from being approved, and record a real, named human approval decision.
quickStart: Review the blocker list.
Approve or reject with a reason once every blocker is cleared.
warnings: No automated actor — agent, system process, or import — can ever set pilot_approved or production_approved, regardless of what a model concluded.
roleNotes: Pilot approval needs chemist/quality/administrator; production approval needs quality/regulatory/production/administrator.

reports.title: Reports
reports.summary: A navigation shell listing every real export already available in its source module.
reports.purpose: One place to find every export in the app — each row links to the workspace that actually produces it.
quickStart: Click Open on any row to go export it from its real source module.
limitations: Audit reports has no dedicated view yet, marked honestly rather than implied.

dataExchange.title: Data Exchange
dataExchange.summary: Bulk CSV/Excel import and export across every module — 41 templates, with a preview-before-commit safety step.
dataExchange.purpose: Move data in or out of FormuLab in bulk without hand-entering every row, while keeping every write reviewable before it happens.
quickStart: Download a Blank or Example file for the template you need.
Fill it in, then Upload.
Review the preview, then Commit import.
roleNotes: An import can never mark anything verified or approved on its own — everything comes in as a draft, exactly like typing it in by hand.
limitations: 2 templates (Stability Protocols and Stability Results) preview and validate but cannot yet be committed — reported honestly per row.

administration.title: Administration
administration.summary: Links to Materials, Regulatory rules, Approval policies, Data Exchange, and Settings, plus the global Test Definitions editor.
administration.purpose: One hub for configuration screens that already exist elsewhere in the app.
quickStart: Click through to Materials, Regulatory, Approval, Data Exchange, or Settings.
limitations: No user or role management — this codebase has no user-management backend, and Administration says so plainly rather than implying one.

materials.title: Materials
materials.summary: Materials, suppliers, packaging components/BOMs, and factory cost profiles.
materials.purpose: The catalog every formula line, cost calculation, and packaging summary is built from.
quickStart: Create a material with whatever is known today.
Attach one or more suppliers.

notebooks.title: Notebooks
notebooks.summary: A runnable notebook editor for exploratory analysis.
notebooks.purpose: Write and run notebook cells against the app's bundled Python/R runtime.
quickStart: Open a notebook and run a cell with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.
limitations: Desktop-only — shows an honest empty state in a browser dev session.

files.title: Files
files.summary: A file browser and previewer across your session folders.
files.purpose: Browse, preview, and open files produced by your sessions and runs.
quickStart: Browse into a folder; click a file to preview it.

runs.title: Runs
runs.summary: History of every executed command or computation, with reproduce and log access.
runs.purpose: See what ran, when, and with what result — and re-run or inspect it.
quickStart: Filter by search or status; expand a run to see its recipe.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.summary: Your AI-assisted research session list — pinned above Settings, latest 8 shown by default.
sessions.purpose: The entry point for the agent/chat-driven research workflow: start a new session or reopen a past one.
quickStart: Click New to start a session.
Click a past session to reopen it.
warnings: Deleting a session is confirmed first — it is not silently removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: General, Appearance, Models, Python runtime, Compute, and Privacy configuration.
settings.purpose: Configure the app itself — theme, locale, model provider, runtime, compute targets, and privacy options.
quickStart: Pick a section from the sidebar-style list on the left.

workingDraft.definition: The current, editable, unsaved state of a formula — never approved, never exported as final.

savedVersion.definition: An immutable, numbered snapshot of a formula, created by Save version. Editing it again creates a new version.

approvalRole.definition: One of researcher, chemist, quality, regulatory, production, or administrator — the only roles that can ever approve a version, and only some of them for each approval gate.

blockingFinding.definition: A validation, compatibility, or safety result severe enough to prevent approval until resolved by a named human.

dossier.definition: A per-version, per-jurisdiction collection of regulatory requirements, evidence, and reviews for a formula.

evidenceConfirmation.definition: A persisted record that a regulatory requirement's evidence has been provided, revocable with a reason.

qsToHundred.definition: A formula line marked to automatically fill to 100% of whatever the other lines leave, never going negative.

landedCost.definition: A material's price plus freight, insurance, duty, tax, and other costs to get it to your factory.

costSnapshot.definition: A frozen record of the exact prices, exchange rates, and factory costs used to cost a formula version at a point in time.

compatibilityFinding.definition: A result from the deterministic ingredient-interaction rule engine — info/warning/error/blocking.

safetyClassification.definition: The deterministic hazard category a formula is placed in — ordinary consumer through prohibited.

doeStudy.definition: One Design of Experiments plan: factors, constraints, responses, a generated run sheet, and (once run) a fitted statistical model.

reverseFormulationCandidate.definition: A proposed formula generated from a benchmark product's declared ingredients, scored on formula fit and evidence confidence separately.

dataExchangeTemplate.definition: One importable/exportable collection's CSV/Excel schema, with its own preview-before-commit validation.

auditEvent.definition: An immutable, timestamped record of a real action taken by a real actor — the basis of every history/audit tab in the app.

watermark.definition: The "R&D DRAFT — NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED" stamp applied to any export whose source formula is not genuinely production_approved.

readinessBlocker.definition: One specific, named reason a formula cannot yet be approved, shown in the Approval workspace.

jurisdiction.definition: The market a regulatory evaluation applies to — Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, or the EAC regional bloc.

testMethodSnapshot.definition: An immutable copy of the standard/method actually used, captured when a test result is recorded. Later edits to the standard or method never change it.
